SELECT p.person_id, p.person_name, p.mobile, p.person_code, p.job_title, p.post_id, pos.post_name, p.org_id, o.org_name, p.account_id, a.account_name FROM exp_person p LEFT JOIN exp_org_unit o ON p.org_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN exp_post pos ON p.post_id = pos.post_id LEFT JOIN exp_account a ON p.account_id = a.account_id
AND p.person_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryParam.personCode}, '%')
AND p.person_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryParam.personName}, '%')
AND p.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryParam.mobile}, '%')
ORDER BY p.created_time DESC

SELECT p.person_id, p.person_code, p.person_name, p.gender, p.mobile, p.email, p.id_card_no, p.job_title, p.org_id, o.org_code, o.org_name, p.post_id, pos.post_code, pos.post_name, p.account_id, a.account_name, a.account_display, p.status, p.entry_date, p.leave_date, p.is_external, p.created_by, creator.account_display as created_name, p.created_time, p.updated_time, p.remark FROM exp_person p LEFT JOIN exp_org_unit o ON p.org_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN exp_post pos ON p.post_id = pos.post_id LEFT JOIN exp_account a ON p.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN exp_account creator ON p.created_by = creator.account_id WHERE p.person_id = #{personId}
